hooks.text: 烤串就是防御塔，可拖放上场并射击、弹射、溅射甚至把敌人推出场外
hooks.excerpt: Drag, drop, and watch your tasty skewers jump into battle. Shoot, bounce, and splash. You can even boop enemies right off the field.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 20多名烧烤大师各带独特天赋，每人都能成为一种流派核心
hooks.excerpt: 20+ Grillmasters, each with unique talents Every Grillmaster can become the core of a different playstyle, letting you craft your own exclusive skewer squad!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 40多种食材效果与100多种随机调味料叠加，让每局烤串队伍重新组合
hooks.excerpt: 40+ tasty and powerful foods Whether they split, bounce, or knock enemies back, combine these effects to master your signature playstyle! 100+ powerful seasonings and items spawn randomly, adding constant depth to your playstyle and making every run a brand new experience!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
